title: Unlock All Cars
features:
Only Work on matcha 
Marche uniquement sur matcha
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local function updateOdometer()
    local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
    if not leaderstats then return end
    
    local odometer = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Odometer") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("odometer")
    
    if odometer and (odometer:IsA("IntValue") or odometer:IsA("NumberValue")) then
        odometer.Value = odometer.Value + 1000000
    end
end

while true do
    updateOdometer()
    wait(5)
end
